subject: Post-call: procurement path & budget owner — BrightMore follow-up
raw_messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Park <julia@brightmore.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: procurement path & budget owner — BrightMore follow-up

Hi Julia — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from my side and three asks so we can move the commercial thread forward:

1) Recap (from call)
- Use case: in-product personalization and search re-ranking across 3 services (web, in-app, recommendations)
- Target go-live: pilot by end of May, production H2 FY26 if pilot hits quality/SLOs
- Desired contract model: preference for predictable unit economics and PO invoicing if possible

2) Asks / next steps
- Can you confirm whether BrightMore will route initial purchase via PO or card? (procurement preference)
- Who is the budget owner / economic buyer for this line item? Name + email please — we want to map approval path and signatory requirements
- Is there interest in purchasing via AWS Marketplace or similar marketplace (consolidated billing)? That changes invoicing and quote flow on our side.

I attached an initial quote and a short mutual action plan draft (link below) — if you can share procurement contact and the budget owner we will: 1) produce a PO-able invoice and MSA redline checklist, 2) prepare a marketplace vs direct pricing comparison, and 3) scope the pilot with Marissa for onboarding.

Attachments: Redwood-Initial-Quote-BrightMore-0421.pdf
Links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1MOP-mutual-action-plan

Thanks — I’ll keep this short so your team can forward to procurement.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

From: Julia Park <julia@brightmore.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mark Li <mark.li@brightmore.com>, Asha Rao <asha.rao@brightmore.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: procurement path & budget owner — BrightMore follow-up

Thanks Ben — good recap and sorry for the delayed reply. Quick answers below and a note on timing:

- Procurement path: Our procurement team prefers PO for platform purchases > $10k. For pilots under $10k we can do card, but they generally want the pilot to be PO'd if we expect to scale.
- Procurement contact: Mark Li (mark.li@brightmore.com) — cc'd here. He owns vendor onboarding and contract routing.
- Budget owner / economic buyer: Asha Rao, VP — Growth & Data (asha.rao@brightmore.com). Asha will need a short one-pager and ROI estimate to approve the budget.
- Marketplace: We like marketplace for consolidated billing, but we need to confirm with finance. If Redwood is on AWS Marketplace with Metered Billing, that would be preferred.
- Timeline: We are targeting an internal decision by the week of 18 May (procurement + Asha).

I attached our procurement questionnaire (completed) — it has some standard SOC2 / data handling follow-ups. Please route any SOC2 artifacts to Mark; he will share with InfoSec.

Attachment: BrightMore-Procurement-Questionnaire-Completed.pdf

Julia
Director, Product Partnerships
Julia Park | BrightMore Analytics
julia@brightmore.com

- Marketplace: Karthik, can you confirm whether Redwood's AWS Marketplace listing supports metered billing with consolidated invoicing (and whether that delays onboarding by > 2 weeks)?

Thanks — I can take the ROI one-pager and a pilot kick-off checklist. Action items I’ll own:
- Draft ROI one-pager (1p): due Fri 24 Apr EOD. Will include pilot success metrics and estimated cost savings based on their sample traffic.
- Pilot onboarding checklist + SOW template to share with Mark so procurement can see the operational plan.
- For AWS Marketplace: Karthik — short answer for BrightMore: Redwood supports metered listing on AWS Marketplace, but for customers wanting consolidated monthly billing combined with PO workflows we usually have to do a hybrid: initial invoice via PO (direct) and then migrate to marketplace metering in month 2. That typically adds 7–14 days of admin. If they must have immediate consolidated marketplace billing for month 1 we can escalate, but expect extra procurement lead time.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
